params.body:
Refs #409. Not closing yet: this changes what the model and the transcript see, so it needs a live Pi check first.

## Reproduction

The issue gives enough to reproduce this without the session file. Its step 4 test is the trigger: a completed assistant message whose last text line is an `[Pit: elided tool call…]` record and that has no `toolCall` block. Before this change, Pit's `turn_end` boundary returned nothing for such a message, so the run settled with no tool result and no notice. The new test `test/globals/imitated-calls.test.ts` builds that exact message on a real Pi `SessionManager`. A mutation probe that disables the notice makes its two positive tests fail (`expected undefined to be true`).

## Changes

- **Detect it and say so (proposal 1).** `src/context/imitated-calls.ts` flags a completed reply that makes no tool call and whose last line starts with the elided-call prefix. At `turn_end`, Pit appends a `pit.imitated-call` notice saying no tool ran and the action did not happen, and returns `continue: true` so the model gets one more response to make the call.
  - **Loop guard:** if the reply right after a notice repeats the mistake, it gets the notice again but no continuation. A later slip, after a normal reply, counts as new.
  - **Not flagged:** a reply that also makes a tool call, a record quoted inside prose or a code block, and an aborted reply.
  - **What the user sees:** a one-line warning, `▲ No tool ran · the reply ended with an elided-call record, not a call · Pit asked the model to make the call`. The expanded view shows the model-facing text.
- **Say in the record that it isn't a call (proposal 3).** Elided-call records now end with `· already ran; writing this text runs nothing`, on both Pi and pi-durable. The prefix is unchanged, so edits already in sessions are still recognized as elided.
- CHANGELOG and `docs/reference.md` are updated.

## Not in this PR

- **Proposal 2** (a stub format the model never writes itself) would undo #292's choice of not leaving a copyable stub call. Better to wait and see whether 1 and 3 are enough.
- **Proposal 4** (a session-analysis count) needs a new field in the `sessions.readEvents` jq projection. It's a good follow-up for measuring before and after.
- **pi-durable:** these hosts get the new record text but not the turn-end check.

## Validation

- [x] `delivery.validate({ coverage: true, packageCheck: true })`: check, tests, coverage, and package check all pass
- [x] Mutation probe on the new tests
- [ ] Live Pi check: `/reload`, have a reply end with a record and no call, and confirm the warning row and that the model continues once
